description: REST API that validates, parses and generates EU e-invoices: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD / Factur-X, Peppol BIS, French rules BR-FR, CIUS-RO, HR-CIUS, FatturaPA, KSeF FA(3), EN 16931.
rules: Authenticate with the header 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>'; the base URL is https://einvoice-api-main-f5141d8.zuplo.app.
Send the invoice to POST /v1/validate as the raw request body (PDF or XML) or as multipart with a part named 'file'; the format is detected from the content.
An invalid invoice is HTTP 200 with "valid": false. Only fatal and error findings make it invalid; check 'valid', not the HTTP status.
Each Schematron finding has a docUrl with the official rule text; use it to explain the error instead of guessing.
Validate every invoice before sending it. POST /v1/generate already validates its output and answers 422 with findings instead of an invalid document.
When converting a parsed invoice (POST /v1/parse) into another format, remove context.specificationIdentifier: BT-24 is set from the format parameter.
Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json; show 'detail' to the user. On 503 retry after the Retry-After header.
The API validates, parses and generates documents only; delivery through Peppol, SDI, KSeF or a French platform needs an access point.
